title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15

ai_review.summary: Matrix‑sourced recording with audience patches and tape hiss, but captures the historic first Touch of Grey and a blazing Shakedown Street/​Stella Blue second set.
ai_review.review: This September 15, 1982 Capital Centre show is remembered for the debut of Touch of Grey and a high‑octane second set featuring Shakedown Street, Stella Blue and a fiery Saint of Circumstance.  The audio is a patched mix of soundboard and audience sources – clear enough to enjoy the performances but marred by hiss and occasional audience bleed.  Overall the musical performance shines despite the technical imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the show’s energy, historic moments and strong playing (average 4‑star comments), while many note significant recording flaws that keep the overall rating around a solid but not outstanding level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Portions of Playin' > Crazy Fingers are audience‑patched; noticeable cassette hiss after the patch; otherwise a decent mix with some clear moments but overall not pristine.

standout_songs: Touch of Grey (first ever live performance)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual structure with several Playing‑in‑the‑Band jams weaving through the set; first set feels like a second set, while the second half builds into extended jams and a memorable encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for smooth, energetic playing – ‘going nuts’ on Saint of Circumstance and delivering a solid Shakedown Street.
band_member_comments.Phil: Listeners note that the patched SBD mix actually brings out Phil’s bass nicely; his low‑end presence is felt throughout the jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: His vocal delivery and occasional exclamation (‘what the fuck you gonna do now!’) are highlighted, especially on Saint of Circumstance.
